EVERY object must be entirely within its cell, including shadow, with minimum 48px left/right and 80px top/bottom transparent blank. No sprite piece may cross a cell border. Row1 centers at y256, row2 centers at y768. Object maximum width280px, maximum height330px. Strong readable 2:1 axonometric pixel art and consistent light from upper left. Keep original identities/materials and all anatomy/architecture intact, crisp deliberately painted pixels rather than vector primitives. Row1 left to right: olive military field desk normal with drawers and steel legs, SAME desk overturned fully upside-down tabletop grounded fourlegs upwards, closed military double locker, SAME locker open with aperture.
